These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## List Zones

Lists all 17 power zones with their name and rail.

**How to use it** — press `l`.

## Get Zones

Shows which power zones are currently on. Needs a telemetry sample.

**How to use it** — press `g`.

## Set Zone

Switches one power zone on or off. Zone 9 is the board-manager LED, not a power rail.

**How to use it** — press `s`. At the prompt, enter: zone number and 1 or 0.

**What you enter** — `zone`, `on`.

## Set Zone Mask

Sets every user-controllable zone at once from a bit mask; bit 0 is zone 1.

**How to use it** — press `m`. At the prompt, enter: the awake zone mask.

**What you enter** — `mask`.

## Get Power State

Prints the most recent power telemetry sample.

**How to use it** — press `t`.

## Stream Power

Streams battery, charger and power-zone telemetry to the host at the given rate. 0 stops the stream.

**How to use it** — press `o`. At the prompt, enter: Sample Time in milliseconds.

**What you enter** — `stream_rate_ms`.

**See also:** [Power Management panel](../panels/power-management.md) — the on-screen panel for this.
